verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community comment listing 'code owners' and 'protected branches' among GitHub Team features that are lost when downgrading to Free on private repos. This implies GitHub ships a code-owners capability alongside branch protection, but nothing documents path-based ownership or required owner approval. missing for 10: first-party documentation of CODEOWNERS path ownership, evidence that owner approval can be required before merge (e.g. via branch protection), hands-on corroboration.
